claims: One-person company with '30 AI employees'; 129,000 people have already downloaded the setup for free
GStack is one system where each role feeds the next: CEO plans, Eng Manager builds the plan, QA Lead tests, and so on
It has memory and learns from its own bugs 'so it never makes the same mistake twice'
how_to_steps: Go to the GStack GitHub repo and install it into Claude Code
Use the role commands in sequence (plan with CEO, review with eng manager/designer, QA, ship)

relevance.why: A free, well-known-author Claude Code role pipeline is exactly what a solo founder lacks: plan review, design review, QA and release discipline without hiring. Transcript's '30 employees' is inflated (repo says 23 tools) but the shape is right.

implement_score.why: Clone garrytan/gstack, run /plan-ceo-review and /qa on the next feature; a couple of hours to evaluate. Compare against the existing Council-gate and code-review flow; adopt the pieces that are missing (release manager, doc engineer).

verify: Confirm garrytan/gstack on GitHub, license, stars, and that it is maintained
How the 'learns from its own bugs' memory works and where it stores data
